criteria: This file parses as strict JSON.
No duplicate target ID is assigned incompatible publication actions without an explicit cross-reference.
routing.quarantine, links.internal_integrity, pages.metadata, pages.headings, content.leaks, and inventory.discovered_indexables pass or have a documented non-content dependency.
A content-only patch is not credited for a theme, plugin, header, runtime, media, or performance failure.
Search every published page for certification, benchmark, best, safe, secure, accredited, expert, roadmap, comprehensive, guaranteed, and revolutionizing claims.
Each retained high-risk claim has a named reviewer, dated primary source, scope, method, and limitation.
No draft or quarantined target appears in sitemaps, archives, schema, navigation, or related-post links.
Restore one representative page, one post, one custom post type, and one term in staging from retained exports.
Verify exact original fields and then reapply the approved patch.
Do not promote the staging database wholesale without reconciling production users, comments, registration settings, and newer content.
Use a scoped deployment manifest listing exact IDs and fields after staging acceptance.
Repeat the full crawl and browser verification on production before closing any finding.
